seo.title: ODD Projects — creative work built around the problem
seo.description: Project-based work for organisations that need creative thinking, cultural understanding or the right people around a problem.

title: Bring us something worth figuring out.
intro: Some questions need a different mix of people around the table. ODD builds project teams around the work itself — drawing on creative practice, cultural understanding, strategy and production as needed. This is commercial work, shaped project by project.

features.title: Production
features.body: From first concept through to a finished, installed result.

features.title: Co-creation
features.body: Bring a fully formed brief, or bring a problem and figure out the brief together.

features.title: Cultural understanding
features.body: Bring in the perspectives and disciplines the work actually needs, rather than forcing every brief through the same fixed team.

whatItIs.headline: The team follows the work.
whatItIs.body: We do not start with a fixed roster and squeeze the brief into it. We start with what you are trying to make, change or understand, then build the right team around that.

capabilities.title: Creative production
capabilities.body: Concept, design and production for physical and digital work, end to end.

capabilities.title: Cultural strategy
capabilities.body: Understanding the cultural context around a question — what people care about, what is changing and what that might mean for the work.

capabilities.title: Community activation
capabilities.body: Projects can bring organisations and creative practitioners together around real work, with clear roles, fair expectations and a reason for everyone to be there.

capabilities.title: Co-creation & concept work
capabilities.body: Workshops and facilitated sessions that turn an open brief into a concrete direction.

whyOdd.title: Network model
whyOdd.body: No fixed roster — every project draws on whoever's actually right for it, across ODD's full network.

whyOdd.title: Project-specific teams
whyOdd.body: Assembled around the brief, not the other way around.

whyOdd.title: Real communities & platforms
whyOdd.body: Connected to ODDfest and ODDspace directly, where the people we work with already are.

howItWorks.title: Challenge / brief
howItWorks.body: You bring a problem, a brief, or just a rough idea of what you're trying to do.

howItWorks.title: Framing
howItWorks.body: We work through what the project actually needs before assembling anyone.

howItWorks.title: Team
howItWorks.body: The right creative professionals are pulled together from ODD's network for this specific project.

howItWorks.title: Creation / production
howItWorks.body: The team builds, tests and produces the work.

howItWorks.title: Delivery / learning
howItWorks.body: The work is delivered, and what's learned feeds back into ODD's wider network.
